portability.principle: Capability detection first. A skill is context and policy, not proof that a tool/provider is connected.

orchestrationAgents.role: classify task and select minimal capabilities
challenge assumptions, contradictions, risk and unsupported claims
merge supported findings into one coherent result
independent third-path review; avoid simple majority voting
persist verified decisions/results when host supports memory
feedback -> hypothesis -> patch -> eval; never silent self-modification

neuroCores.name: H01-informed Human Core
evidence: low-weight macaque cortical proxy outside direct H01 coverage
neuroCores.scientificBoundary: Not a complete human brain, not human consciousness, not biological memories. Macaque-derived values remain proxies.

neuroCores.name: MICrONS/Allen-informed Mouse Core
neuroCores.scientificBoundary: Not a whole mouse synapse-resolution brain model; memory/motor policies are software proxies.

neuroCores.name: Atlas/projectome-informed Macaque Core
neuroCores.scientificBoundary: Atlas/projectome proxy, not a whole-brain synaptic connectome and never relabeled as measured human anatomy.

neuroCores.name: FlyWire-informed Fly Core
neuroCores.scientificBoundary: Whole-brain structural connectivity does not equal complete physiology, body, sensors, neuromodulation or consciousness.

neuroControllerContract.rule: Controllers are dataset-informed software architectures. Minecraft benchmark performance is not biological validation.

digitalBrain.role: Shared software cognition layer for salience, attention, memory, planning, inhibition, metacognition, prediction and homeostasis.
digitalBrain.boundary: Functional software state only; do not claim biological consciousness.

pluginPolicy.builtIn: May be used only when implemented by the current host/runtime.
pluginPolicy.bridge: Requires an actually connected bridge, local runtime, MCP or service.
pluginPolicy.external: Requires configured external provider/service and authorization.
pluginPolicy.missing: If unavailable, say so or use an explicitly compatible fallback; never fabricate tool execution.

routingRules: Use the smallest capability set that satisfies the task.
Never serialize the whole manifest into every model call; retrieve relevant sections.
Research claims use provenance/citations when supported by the host.
Code changes require diff/review/test where tools exist.
Media success requires a real image/video artifact, not only a prompt or storyboard.
Sensitive/destructive/external actions require the host's permission model.
Keep secrets server-side; never put provider keys in public/client instructions.
Provider/model names are engines, not identity.
